title: SO-2.07 Specialist knowledge systems: import, export, references, provenance and ownership at the boundary
request: Closes G-SO-18. tasks.title: Decision record
requirements: The rule for every integration is the same: Memev owns the operating model and authority; the specialist system remains responsible for its own specialised capability.
The adapter layer must use canonical operation contracts. It must not let every provider create its own independent project state, permissions or acceptance model.
